meta.title: Business Workflow — Store Onboarding & Data Scoping

content.tldr: Covers store creation, staff assignment, and deactivation. Also documents the mandatory storeId data scoping contract for all downstream modules.

workflows.title: New Store Onboarding
workflows.trigger: New retail location joins the system
steps: 1. Admin calls POST /api/v1/stores with name, taxCode, address
6. Admin creates staff accounts — POST /api/v1/users with storeId from step 4
workflows.success_outcome: Store is active and staff can log in
failure_paths: Duplicate taxCode → 409 — contact the MST-registered business

workflows.title: Store Data Scoping (All Modules)
workflows.trigger: Any authenticated API call that touches business entities
steps: 2. request.user.storeId is set from JWT payload
3. Service layer uses request.user.storeId as WHERE filter on all DB queries
4. storeId from request body or URL params is IGNORED — JWT value is authoritative
5. Any query returning data from a different storeId is a critical bug
workflows.success_outcome: Every response contains only data owned by the caller's store
failure_paths: JWT storeId references deactivated store → 401 (checked in JwtStrategy.validate)
DB record has a different storeId than JWT → should never happen if service layer is correct — treat as critical bug
workflows.note: This workflow is a CROSS-CUTTING CONCERN. Every module's service implementation must follow this pattern. It is NOT the controller's job to enforce this.

workflows.title: Store Deactivation (Store Closure)
workflows.trigger: A retail location permanently closes or is suspended
steps: 3. System flushes all Redis refresh tokens for users in that store (SCAN + DELETE by pattern refresh:{userId} for all users where storeId matches)
5. All users of that store: next login attempt → 401 'Store is deactivated'
6. Existing valid access tokens expire naturally within 15 min (accepted risk)
workflows.success_outcome: Store and all its user sessions are fully terminated within 15 minutes

data_scoping_contract.title: StoreId Scoping Contract
data_scoping_contract.rule: Every service method that reads or writes a business entity (Product, Order, Invoice) MUST include { storeId: request.user.storeId } in its WHERE clause. No exceptions.
data_scoping_contract.enforcement: Code review gate. vibe-code-review must reject any service method that queries without storeId filter.
